what.en: Item 8: the foreign LLC's principal office, wherever it is, abroad included (the form has country and postal-code boxes). A street or mailing address is accepted.
what.zh: 第8项：外州（外国）LLC 的主要办事处地址，不限所在地，境外亦可（表格设有国家和邮编栏）。可填街道地址或邮寄地址。

ifNone.en: Give the head office address as it is, including one in China or elsewhere abroad.
ifNone.zh: 如实填写总部地址，在中国或其他境外地区均可。

confirmations.quote: It is organized under the laws of: (set forth state or foreign country)
Provide the street or mailing address of the principal office of the foreign entity.
(8) the address of the principal office of the foreign filing entity;

what.en: Item 9C: the registered office, a Texas street address where the registered agent can be served in person during business hours. Not a P.O. box, mailbox service or answering service.
what.zh: 第9C项：注册办事处，须为德州街道地址，营业时间内可当面向注册代理人送达法律文书。不得为邮政信箱、信箱代收服务或电话应答服务。

ifNone.en: Hire a Texas registered agent (a Texas resident or a company authorized in Texas) and use its office address.
ifNone.zh: 聘请德州注册代理人（德州居民个人或获准在德州经营的公司），填写其办公地址。

confirmations.quote: 9C. The business address of the registered agent and the registered office address is:
The registered office address must be located at a street address where service of process may be personally served on the entity’s registered agent
Each filing entity and each foreign filing entity shall designate and continuously maintain in this state:

what.en: Item 11: the name and address of each governing person (manager or member); a street, business or P.O. box address is accepted and no Texas address is required. The form has a country box, but only the form itself signals that an address abroad is accepted. The filing is public.
what.zh: 第11项：每位管理人（经理或成员）的姓名和地址；可用街道、办公或邮政信箱地址，不要求德州地址。表格设有国家栏，但只有表格本身表明可填境外地址。该文件会公开。

ifNone.en: Use each person's own business address; the Secretary of State suggests a business or P.O. box address over a home address for privacy. For someone with only an address abroad, Placetta asks the Secretary of State before writing it in the country box.
ifNone.zh: 填写每个人自己的办公地址；为保护隐私，州务卿建议用办公地址或邮政信箱而不是住址。若某人只有境外地址，Placetta 会先向州务卿办公室确认，再填入国家栏。

notes: Form 304 (Revised 09/26), the Secretary of State's Form 304 instructions page, and Tex. Bus. Orgs. Code 9.004(b)(8)-(10) and 5.201. In Texas law 'foreign entity' means formed outside Texas; the form's 'state or foreign country' line and country boxes show a non-US LLC registers on the same form. A line is marked foreign_ok only when at least two sources say a non-local or foreign address is accepted: the principal office qualifies (form, instructions and statute all describe the foreign entity's own office), the governing persons do not (only the form's country box).
